answers.q: How many days does a customer have to return a product, and when does that period start?
answers.reference: 30 days, counted from the day the order reaches the status delivered.

answers.q: Can a customer return opened software?
answers.reference: No. Opened software, custom-built products and gift cards are not returnable.

answers.q: How long after inspection is a refund issued, and to which payment method?
answers.reference: Within 5 business days after the returned item passes inspection, to the original payment method.

answers.q: When are shipping costs refunded on a return?
answers.reference: Only when the item arrived damaged or was not what the customer ordered.

answers.q: What warranty does the shop give on webcams?
answers.reference: 12 months; a defective item is replaced or refunded without a return fee.

answers.q: What does support need from a customer to handle a defective product?
answers.reference: The order id and a short description of the defect.

answers.q: Can an order that is already shipped still be cancelled?
answers.reference: No. Once shipped, the customer waits for delivery and uses the normal 30-day return window.

answers.q: How much does express delivery cost and how fast is it?
answers.reference: A flat 9.90 EUR, delivered in 1 to 2 business days.

answers.q: Does a 120 EUR order with standard delivery pay for shipping?
answers.reference: No. Orders above 100 EUR ship free with the standard option.

answers.q: An order is paid at 16:00 on a business day. When does it leave the warehouse?
answers.reference: The next business day, because only orders paid before 14:00 leave the same day.

answers.q: When does a tracking number become active?
answers.reference: About 12 hours after dispatch.

answers.q: What happens if tracking shows no movement for 5 business days?
answers.reference: Support opens an investigation with the carrier.

answers.q: How is a 32-inch monitor delivered, and how long does it take?
answers.reference: On a pallet, after a phone call to agree on a time slot; delivery takes 5 to 8 business days.

answers.q: When is a parcel considered lost, and what does the shop do then?
answers.reference: When it is not delivered 10 business days after dispatch; the shop ships a replacement or refunds the customer, whichever the customer prefers.

answers.q: What does the status pending mean, and how long is a pending order held?
answers.reference: Payment has not been confirmed yet; pending orders are held for 48 hours and then moved to cancelled if payment does not arrive.

answers.q: Can the customer change the delivery address after the order has shipped?
answers.reference: No. Once shipped, the delivery address can no longer be changed.

answers.q: Can a cancelled order be moved back to paid?
answers.reference: No. A cancelled order must not be moved back to another status; a new order has to be created instead.

answers.q: Which statuses can a paid order move to?
answers.reference: Shipped or cancelled.

answers.q: Which order statuses are final?
answers.reference: Delivered and cancelled.

answers.q: Who is allowed to read the audit log?
answers.reference: Only users with the admin role.

answers.q: What steps should an admin follow to change an order status?
answers.reference: Look up the order and check its status, check the allowed transitions, change the status (it needs human approval in the workspace), then read the order again to confirm.

answers.q: What should an admin do with a pending order older than 48 hours?
answers.reference: Check the payment provider first: with no payment, move it to cancelled; with a payment, move it to paid.

answers.q: What does a burst of denied audit entries for one user usually mean, and what should be done?
answers.reference: Usually a viewer tried to change an order; report it to the security contact.

answers.q: A customer says their parcel shipped 12 business days ago and never arrived. What should support do?
answers.reference: Check the order is shipped; after more than 10 business days the parcel counts as lost, so the shop ships a replacement or refunds the customer, whichever the customer prefers.

answers.q: An order was delivered 20 days ago and the customer wants to return an unused keyboard in its original packaging. Is that allowed?
answers.reference: Yes. It is within the 30-day window that starts at delivery, and the item is unused and in its original packaging.

answers.q: A paid order needs to be cancelled. Is that free, and what happens to the payment?
answers.reference: Yes, cancelling is free while the order is pending or paid (paid to cancelled is an allowed transition), and the payment is refunded automatically.

answers.q: How long does the supplier cover switch failures on mechanical keyboards, and what should the customer send?
answers.reference: 24 months; the customer sends the order id and a photo.

answers.q: Which keyboard parts are not covered by the supplier warranty?
answers.reference: Keycaps, cables and wrist rests.
